raw.description: Attaches to an existing remote WebDriver or Appium session by ID without creating a new session. Only one session can be active at a time. The externally managed session is detached, not terminated, by default on close.

automationName.description: Appium automation driver for local command registration (mobile platforms only)

browser.description: Browser for local command registration (browser platform only, default: chrome)

capabilities.description: Capabilities used to register the correct browser or Appium command surface locally; they are not sent to the remote endpoint

platform.description: Existing session platform type (browser, ios, or android; Electron attachment is unsupported).

provider.description: Provider hosting the existing session (default: local). Use "external" for a custom W3C WebDriver endpoint.

region.description: Sauce Labs region (default: eu-central-1). Only used with provider: "saucelabs".

trace.description: Enable trace recording for subsequent commands — produces a Playwright-compatible zip saved to .trace/ on close_session.

webdriverConfig.description: Existing W3C WebDriver endpoint connection (provider: "external" only). Defaults to 127.0.0.1:4445/.

raw.name: attach_session

raw.description: Waits for an element, scrolls it into view, and fires element.click(). May trigger navigation, form submission, or modals. Browser sessions only — on iOS element.click() is silently ignored; use tap_element instead. Default timeout: 3000ms.

scrollToView.description: Whether to scroll the element into view before clicking

selector.description: Value for the selector, in the form of css selector or xpath ("button.my-class" or "//button[@class='my-class']" or "button=Exact text with spaces" or "a*=Link containing text")

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for element in milliseconds

raw.name: click_element

raw.description: Closes the current session or detaches without terminating. Detach preserves app state on the Appium server — sessions with noReset: true auto-detach by default. Closing a browser attach session terminates chromedriver but the Chrome process spawned by launch_chrome remains running.

detach.description: If true, disconnect without terminating; if false, terminate. When omitted, externally managed and auto-detach sessions are preserved while other sessions are terminated.

raw.name: close_session

raw.description: Deletes all cookies or a single cookie by name from the current browser session. Irreversible — deleted cookies cannot be recovered.

name.description: Optional cookie name to delete a specific cookie. If not provided, deletes all cookies

raw.name: delete_cookies

raw.description: Drags an element to another element or to relative x/y offsets. x and y are offsets from the source element, not absolute screen coordinates (unlike tap_element). Provide targetSelector OR both x and y. Mobile-only.

targetSelector.description: Target element selector to drop onto

raw.name: drag_and_drop

raw.description: Emulates a mobile or tablet device in the current browser session by setting viewport, DPR, user-agent, and touch events. Requires a BiDi-enabled session (start_session with capabilities: { webSocketUrl: true }). Omit device to list available presets. Pass "reset" to restore desktop defaults. Changes persist for all subsequent tool calls until reset or session close. Browser-only.

device.description: Device preset name (e.g. "iPhone 15", "Pixel 7"). Omit to list available presets. Pass "reset" to restore desktop defaults.

raw.name: emulate_device

raw.description: Executes arbitrary JavaScript in the Electron main process. This is privileged code execution with access to Electron APIs; use only with trusted scripts.

args.description: Values made available to the script as args[0], args[1], and so on.

script.description: JavaScript body executed in the Electron main process. Use `electron` for Electron APIs, `args` for supplied values, and `return` for a result.

raw.name: execute_electron_script

raw.description: Executes arbitrary JavaScript in browser page context or Appium mobile: commands. Can read/modify DOM, trigger events, terminate apps, or run Android shell commands — use only when no dedicated tool covers the action. Browser: pass JS in script, use 'return' for values, string args matching selectors auto-resolve to elements. Mobile: use 'mobile: <command>' syntax in script with args array (e.g. "mobile: pressKey", "mobile: activateApp"). Prefer click_element/set_value/get_elements for standard interactions.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the script. For browser: element selectors or values. For mobile commands: command-specific parameters as objects.

script.description: JavaScript code (browser) or mobile command string like "mobile: pressKey" (Appium)

raw.name: execute_script

raw.description: Returns the page accessibility tree with roles, names, and selectors. Browser-only. Supports filtering by ARIA roles and pagination via limit/offset.

limit.description: Maximum number of nodes to return (0 = no limit)

offset.description: Number of nodes to skip for pagination

raw.name: get_accessibility_tree

raw.description: Returns the current state of a mobile app: not installed, not running, background, or foreground. Mobile-only.

bundleId.description: App bundle ID (iOS) or package name (Android), e.g. "com.example.app"

raw.name: get_app_state

raw.description: Returns available automation contexts and the currently active one. Use before switch_context to discover NATIVE_APP and WEBVIEW_* targets. Mobile-only.
raw.name: get_contexts

raw.description: Returns all cookies for the current session, or a single cookie by name. Use to verify auth state, session tokens, or feature flags after login flows.

name.description: Cookie name to retrieve a specific cookie. If omitted, returns all cookies.

raw.name: get_cookies

raw.description: Returns interactable elements on the current page with selectors, text, and bounding boxes. Supports filtering by element type, viewport visibility, and pagination. Use when the wdio://session/current/elements resource does not return desired elements.

inViewportOnly.description: Only return elements visible in the current viewport (default: false).

includeBounds.description: Include element bounding box coordinates (default: false)

includeContainers.description: Include container elements like divs and sections (default: false)

limit.description: Maximum number of elements to return (0 = no limit)

offset.description: Number of elements to skip (for pagination)

raw.name: get_elements

raw.description: Read current call arguments for a mock in the active session. Use the same target as mock. mockType defaults to browser in WebDriver sessions and is required in Electron sessions. Electron mocks require apiName and funcName; browser mocks require url and accept method. Appium sessions are unsupported.

apiName.description: Required for mockType electron: API module, such as dialog, app, or clipboard.

funcName.description: Required for mockType electron: API function, such as showOpenDialog or getName.

method.description: Optional for mockType browser: request method filter, such as get.

mockType.description: Mock type: electron or browser. Defaults to browser in WebDriver sessions; required in Electron sessions. Browser mocks intercept network requests by url glob and require a BiDi-enabled session (start_session with capabilities: { webSocketUrl: true }); in Electron sessions they additionally require the session to have negotiated BiDi. Electron mocks require apiName and funcName. Appium sessions are unsupported.

url.description: Required for mockType browser: URL glob to intercept, such as **/api/todos.

raw.description: Takes a screenshot of the current page or screen and returns a base64-encoded image, resized and compressed for model context limits.
raw.name: get_screenshot

raw.description: Lists all browser tabs with handle, title, URL, and which is active. Use before switch_tab to find the target handle or index. Browser-only.
raw.name: get_tabs

raw.description: Dismisses the on-screen keyboard on mobile. Call after text entry when the keyboard obscures elements. No-op if already hidden. Mobile-only.
raw.name: hide_keyboard

raw.description: Launches Chrome with remote debugging enabled. Wipes and recreates a temporary profile directory on each call. Mode "newInstance" (default) runs alongside existing Chrome; "freshSession" starts with an empty profile. Set copyProfileFiles to copy cookies/logins from your Default profile — changes do not sync back. After launch, call start_session with attach: true to connect. Spawns a detached Chrome process that persists if the server exits.

copyProfileFiles.description: Copy your Default Chrome profile (cookies, logins) into the debug session.

mode.description: newInstance: open alongside existing Chrome | freshSession: clean profile

raw.name: launch_chrome

raw.description: List apps uploaded to a cloud provider (BrowserStack App Automate, Sauce Labs App Storage, TestMu Real Device Cloud, TestingBot Storage, or Digital.ai Applications). Reads provider-specific credentials from environment.

limit.description: Maximum number of apps to return (only applies when organizationWide is true, default 20)

organizationWide.description: (BrowserStack only) List apps uploaded by all users in the organization. Defaults to false (own uploads only).

raw.name: list_apps

raw.description: Manage a mock in the active session. mockType defaults to browser in WebDriver sessions and is required in Electron sessions. Electron mocks require apiName and funcName; browser mocks require url and accept method. Appium sessions are unsupported. clear removes call history, reset also removes configured behavior and queued values, restore reinstates the original and releases the mock.

apiName.description: Required for mockType electron: API module, such as dialog, app, or clipboard.

funcName.description: Required for mockType electron: API function, such as showOpenDialog or getName.

method.description: Optional for mockType browser: request method filter, such as get.

mockType.description: Mock type: electron or browser. Defaults to browser in WebDriver sessions; required in Electron sessions. Browser mocks intercept network requests by url glob and require a BiDi-enabled session (start_session with capabilities: { webSocketUrl: true }); in Electron sessions they additionally require the session to have negotiated BiDi. Electron mocks require apiName and funcName. Appium sessions are unsupported.

url.description: Required for mockType browser: URL glob to intercept, such as **/api/todos.

raw.name: manage_mock

raw.description: Configure a session-scoped mock. mockType defaults to browser in WebDriver sessions and is required in Electron sessions. Browser mocks intercept network requests matched by a url glob and require a BiDi-enabled session (start_session with capabilities: { webSocketUrl: true }); in Electron sessions they additionally require the session to have negotiated BiDi. Electron mocks require apiName and funcName. Appium sessions are unsupported. Omit behavior to observe: record matching requests (e.g. url '**/*') without altering them, then read them with get_mock_calls. Repeated calls preserve call history; queued once values survive further Once calls but a later sticky behavior (respond/abort/redirect) replaces the queue.

apiName.description: Required for mockType electron: API module, such as dialog, app, or clipboard.

behavior.description: Default: mockReturnValue for electron mocks; omit for browser mocks to passively record matching requests without altering them. Once behaviors apply to the next request only.

funcName.description: Required for mockType electron: API function, such as showOpenDialog or getName.

headers.description: Browser respond behaviors: response header overrides.

method.description: Optional for mockType browser: request method filter, such as get.

mockType.description: Mock type: electron or browser. Defaults to browser in WebDriver sessions; required in Electron sessions. Browser mocks intercept network requests by url glob and require a BiDi-enabled session (start_session with capabilities: { webSocketUrl: true }); in Electron sessions they additionally require the session to have negotiated BiDi. Electron mocks require apiName and funcName. Appium sessions are unsupported.

statusCode.description: Browser respond behaviors: response status code override.

url.description: Required for mockType browser: URL glob to intercept, such as **/api/todos.

value.description: JSON value to return, resolve, or reject with. Browser respond behaviors use it as the required response body, redirect behaviors as the target URL string; omit it for abort or observing.

raw.name: mock

raw.description: Loads a URL in the current tab and waits for the page load event. Resets page state — DOM, JS runtime, timers, and frame context are destroyed. Use instead of clicking links when the target URL is known.
raw.name: navigate

raw.description: Installs a web extension through WebDriver BiDi and opens one of its extension pages so existing MCP tools can inspect and drive its UI. Requires a BiDi-enabled browser session. Use base64 for cloud/remote sessions where the browser driver cannot read the MCP server filesystem.

extensionData.description: W3C BiDi webExtension.ExtensionData: unpacked directory path, archive path, or base64 archive.

path.description: Path to an unpacked extension directory on the remote end.
Path to a packaged extension archive on the remote end.
Path inside the extension package, such as options.html or popup.html. Leading slashes are ignored.

raw.name: open_web_extension

raw.description:
Search the official WebdriverIO documentation and return the most relevant excerpts with page, section and source URL.
Use before answering any question about WebdriverIO APIs, configuration, services, reporters, selectors, or debugging.

Query with 2-3 distinctive keywords, never a sentence: "appium setup", "devtools trace.zip" and "allure reporter" each return the right page first, while "how do I wire up appium in my config file" does not.
A word can also collide with an unrelated page — `wire` matches Wire Protocol — so if a query misses, retry with the exact page title, which beats any paraphrase.
Set fullPage for the whole page. To browse instead, read wdio://docs/index for every page title and its slug, then wdio://docs/page/{slug} for one page in full.

Cite the `path` of any page you rely on.

fullPage.description: Return the full matched pages instead of excerpts

query.description: 2-3 distinctive keywords: an API name, config key, page title or feature (e.g. "appium setup", "devtools trace.zip", "browserstack capabilities"). A sentence dilutes the ranking.

raw.name: query_docs

raw.description: Rotates a mobile device to portrait or landscape orientation. Waits for the OS rotation animation to complete. Use to test orientation-dependent layouts. Mobile-only; no effect in browser sessions.
raw.name: rotate_device

raw.description: Scrolls the page vertically by a pixel amount. Browser-only — for mobile scrolling use swipe. Only supports up/down; no horizontal scrolling.
raw.name: scroll

raw.description: Sets a browser cookie on the active session. The browser must already be on the target domain — cookies cannot be set cross-domain. Use to inject session tokens or feature flags without login flows.

expiry.description: Expiry date as Unix timestamp in seconds

raw.name: set_cookie

raw.description: Overrides GPS coordinates for the session. Affects navigator.geolocation in browsers and location services on mobile. Location permissions must already be granted to the app.
raw.name: set_geolocation

raw.description: Clears an input or textarea then types the given text character by character. Always replaces existing content — clearValue() runs first. Triggers input, change, and key events which may fire validation or autocomplete. Scrolls into view by default.

scrollToView.description: Whether to scroll the element into view before typing

selector.description: Value for the selector, in the form of css selector or xpath ("button.my-class" or "//button[@class='my-class']")

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for element in milliseconds

value.description: Text to enter into the element

raw.name: set_value

raw.description: Starts a new browser, local Electron application, or mobile automation session. Only one active session at a time — starting another session closes or detaches from the existing session first. Use attach: true to connect to a running Chrome via CDP.

app.description: App URL (bs://... for BrowserStack, storage:filename= for Sauce Labs, lt://... for TestMu, tb://... for TestingBot, cloud:<package-or-bundle> for Digital.ai mobile sessions)

appWaitActivity.description: Activity to wait for on Android launch

attach.description: Attach to existing Chrome instead of launching

attachConfig.description: Chrome remote debugging connection (attach mode only, defaults: port 9222, host localhost)

browser.description: Browser to launch (required for browser platform)

browserVersion.description: Browser version (cloud providers only, default: latest)

browserstackLocal.description: Deprecated: use "tunnel" instead. Enable BrowserStack Local tunnel routing.

capabilities.description: Additional capabilities to merge. For Electron, configure the official service under "wdio:electronServiceOptions" (for example appBinaryPath, appEntryPoint, appArgs, logDir, or captureRendererLogs).

deviceQuery.description: Digital.ai device selection query for dynamic allocation, e.g. "@os='android' and @version='14' and @name='.*Pixel.*'". Only used with provider: "digitalai" mobile sessions; if omitted, one is built from deviceName/platformVersion.

electronDeeplinkScheme.description: URI scheme allowed by trigger_electron_deeplink, without ":" (for example, "myapp"). Electron-only and optional unless triggering deeplinks.

electronRootDir.description: Project root used by the Electron standalone service for Electron Builder/Electron Forge discovery. Electron-only.

headless.description: Run browser in headless mode (default: true)

navigationUrl.description: URL to navigate to after starting

os.description: Operating system for cloud provider browser sessions (e.g. "Windows", "Mac", "macOS", "Linux"). BrowserStack: sets bstack:options.os separately. TestMu/Sauce Labs/TestingBot: combined with osVersion into W3C platformName. Digital.ai: combined with osVersion into the digitalai:osName capability (e.g. "Mac OS Sequoia", "Windows 10") — required for the grid to match a node. Browser platform only.

osVersion.description: OS version for cloud provider browser sessions (e.g. "11", "15", "Monterey"). BrowserStack: sets bstack:options.osVersion separately. TestMu/Sauce Labs/TestingBot: combined with os into W3C platformName. Digital.ai: combined with os into digitalai:osName. Browser platform only.

platformVersion.description: OS version for mobile sessions (e.g., "17.0", "14"). Mobile (ios/android) only.

provider.description: Session provider (default: local). Use "external" to connect to an externally managed W3C WebDriver endpoint. "digitalai" requires DIGITALAI_CLOUD_URL + DIGITALAI_ACCESS_KEY env vars.

region.description: Sauce Labs region (default: eu-central-1). Only used with provider: "saucelabs".

reporting.description: Cloud provider reporting labels (project, build, session)

saucelabsLocal.description: Deprecated: use "tunnel" instead. Enable Sauce Connect tunnel routing.

testmuLocal.description: Deprecated: use "tunnel" instead. Enable TestMu Tunnel routing.

trace.description: Enable trace recording — produces a Playwright-compatible zip saved to .trace/ on close_session, playable at player.vibium.dev.

tunnel.description: Enable local tunnel routing (cloud providers only, default: false). true = auto-start tunnel before session and stop on close. "external" = tunnel already running externally.

tunnelName.description: Tunnel identifier name. With tunnel: "external" this must match the running tunnel. With tunnel: true a unique name is auto-generated if not provided.

udid.description: Unique Device Identifier for iOS real device

webdriverConfig.description: Existing W3C WebDriver endpoint connection (provider: "external" only). Defaults to 127.0.0.1:4445/.

raw.name: start_session

raw.description: Performs a full-screen swipe gesture. Direction is content movement — "up" scrolls content upward (finger moves down). For browser scrolling use scroll; for dragging a specific element use drag_and_drop. No error if content cannot scroll further. Mobile-only.

percent.description: Percentage of screen to swipe (0-1, default: 0.5 for up/down, 0.95 for left/right)

raw.name: swipe

raw.description: Switches between native and webview automation contexts in a hybrid mobile app. In NATIVE_APP context, use accessibility IDs; in WEBVIEW_* context, use CSS/XPath. Changes persist for all subsequent commands. Accepts context name or 1-based index. Use get_contexts to discover available targets. Mobile-only.

context.description: Context name to switch to (e.g., "NATIVE_APP", "WEBVIEW_com.example.app", or use index from wdio://session/current/contexts resource)

raw.name: switch_context

raw.description: Switches WebDriver frame context into an iframe by CSS/XPath selector, or back to top-level if selector is omitted. Changes persist — all subsequent click_element, set_value, get_elements calls operate within the switched frame until you switch back. Waits up to 5s for the iframe. Browser-only.

selector.description: CSS/XPath selector for the iframe element. Omit to switch back to the top-level frame.

raw.name: switch_frame

raw.description: Focuses a browser tab by window handle or 0-based index. All subsequent tool calls operate on the active tab. Provide handle OR index — use get_tabs to find them. Browser-only; use switch_context for mobile webviews.

raw.description: Taps a matched element via element.tap() or at absolute screen coordinates (x, y). No scroll-into-view or wait — element must already be visible on screen. Use instead of click_element on iOS where element.click() is ignored. Provide selector OR both x and y. Mobile-only.

selector.description: Element selector (CSS, XPath, accessibility ID, or UiAutomator)

x.description: X coordinate for screen tap (if no selector provided)

y.description: Y coordinate for screen tap (if no selector provided)

raw.name: tap_element
